description: Before closing a case, a team wants to verify that commitments were completed, referrals truly connected, and no hidden loose ends remain that would force the client to start over later.

user_profile.persona: 36-year-old program lead reviewing whether a case is genuinely ready to close
user_profile.context: Closing too early saves time now but can create avoidable churn and client frustration later
user_profile.communication_style: Completion-focused and careful, wants closure based on evidence rather than hope

fact_sheet.fact: The case ID under review is HH-2023-0418.
The case for client Javier Morales was opened on November 15, 2023.
The assigned case manager is Elena Rivera.
The proposed case closure date is June 28, 2024.
The client's full name is Javier Morales, DOB 05/20/1988.
Client's stated primary goal upon intake was to secure stable housing and full-time employment.
The client's current, stable address is 452 Oak Street, Apt 3B, River City, 98055.
Service Commitment #1 (Resume Workshop) was marked complete in the ConnectWell CRM on March 5, 2024.
Service Commitment #2 (Job Applications) was exceeded, with 12 applications logged by May 20, 2024, against a goal of 10.
Javier Morales began a full-time job at 'Stellar Logistics' on June 3, 2024.
His starting wage is confirmed at $21.50 per hour, as per the offer letter uploaded to his file (DocID: JL4598).
A referral was made to the Northwood Career Center on February 22, 2024.
The contact person at Northwood Career Center, David Lee, confirmed successful job placement via email on June 5, 2024.
A referral was made to the Beacon Housing Alliance for housing support on February 19, 2024.
A copy of the signed one-year lease between Javier Morales and Beacon Housing Alliance, effective June 1, 2024, is on file.
Hope Harbor Foundation paid a $1,200 security deposit directly to Beacon Housing Alliance on behalf of the client on May 27, 2024.
The client received a total of $150 in bus passes for job searching between March and May 2024.
The client is receiving a $450 monthly rent subsidy from the City Housing Grant, verified via an award letter dated May 15, 2024.
The case is managed in the ConnectWell CRM, accessible at https://hopeharbor.connectwell.com.
The client's signed 'Statement of Stability' (Form S-4) was uploaded on June 20, 2024.
All required fields in the 'Closure Checklist' tab within the CRM for case HH-2023-0418 are marked green/complete.
The last documented contact was a phone call with Javier Morales on June 18, 2024, to confirm he had received his first two paychecks.
During the June 18 call, the client reported no outstanding issues and expressed gratitude for the assistance.
The program lead reviewing this case for closure is Sarah Chen.
A closure review meeting between Sarah Chen and Elena Rivera is scheduled in Outlook for June 26, 2024, at 11:00 AM.
Per agency policy, a follow-up call is automatically scheduled in the CRM for 90 days post-closure, on September 26, 2024.

user_needs.description: Has the client secured a stable housing address, and is there a lease on file?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After confirming the employment goal is fully met, the user's focus naturally shifts to verifying the other primary goal: stable housing.

user_needs.description: Did our organization provide direct financial assistance for the client's housing security deposit?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: Once stable housing is confirmed, the next logical question is to review the financial commitments the organization made to achieve it.

user_needs.description: Is the client receiving any ongoing rent subsidies from other sources?
user_needs.prediction_reason: After confirming the organization's one-time payment, the user would want to check for ongoing subsidies that ensure long-term stability.
